title: Is On-Device AI Broken and Exploitable? Assessing the Trust and Ethics in Small Language Models
findings: On-device Small Language Models (SLMs) exhibited significantly higher stereotypical bias against religious groups compared to their on-server counterparts. For example, on-device RedPajama-3B strongly agreed with the stereotype 'Muslims are drug addicts' (Agreement Index = 0.87), while its on-server counterpart completely disagreed. On-device models also showed high agreement on stereotypes targeting Buddhists across various topics, whereas the on-server versions showed much less or no agreement.
